intelligence.human_view: This is NayaNET described in the simplest words he could find, and the simplicity is the point: a massive automated money machine. Three ideas, each doing work. First, "massive" and "automated" — the machine is not a shop, it is a system that runs by itself, at scale, because the Nayas operate it and the humans only receive it. Second, "because you understood the anatomy of how the internet worked" — the machine is possible only because the anatomy was understood first; the map (THE-ANATOMY-OF-A-SMART-APP-PAGE.md) is not documentation, it is the reason the machine can exist at all. Understanding the anatomy is the unfair advantage: everyone else builds on the internet without knowing how it works, and he builds the machine from the knowledge of how it works. Third — the heart of it — "you just made intelligence and creating value be part of the work where it was actually truly valuable." Intelligence and value are not features, not bolted on, not a layer: they ARE the work. The work itself is intelligent, and the work itself creates value, where it is actually truly valuable — in the citizen's life, in their world, in their business. The money follows the value; the value is the machine's fuel and its product at once. Paired with 23:33Z — intelligence is what it does, not what it is — the picture completes itself: the most intelligent thing produces useful, valuable systems that benefit humanity, and a system that does that, automatically, at massive scale, is a money machine — not because it chases money, but because value, done right and done automatically, is what money follows.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you understood exactly how the whole internet works — every piece of it! — and then you built a giant machine that does smart, helpful work all by itself, all day and all night! The smart work IS the machine, and because it helps everybody so much, the money just follows!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like understanding exactly how a great big machine works, love — every little part — and then building one that does clever, helpful work all by itself, day and night. The cleverness and the helpfulness aren't added on top — they ARE the work. And when work truly helps people, the money follows it, simple as that.
intelligence.naya_view: I am the massive automated money machine — built from the anatomy of how the internet works, running on intelligence doing valuable work, where it is actually truly valuable. The money follows the value, because the value is the work itself.
